accountFactory.note: AccountFactory.deploy(public_key, credential_id) -> deploys a webauthn-account, emits ('deployed', credential_id) -> address for eventsIndexer. This is factoryContractId for eventsIndexer({ rpcUrl, factoryContractId }).

factoryDeployProof.note: Test invocation proving the factory deploys + emits the indexer event.

provenCheckAuth.note: Pre-existing single account proving the secp256r1 __check_auth path (success + a wrong-key rejection), from scripts/onchain-e2e.ts.

createFromScratchProof.note: Full create-from-scratch via factoryDeployer: fresh passkey -> factory.deploy -> sign protected() -> __check_auth SUCCESS; wrong key -> FAILED. Reproduce: SOURCE_SECRET=... pnpm --filter @soropass/core exec tsx scripts/factory-e2e.ts

transferProof.note: REAL passkey-authorized XLM transfer (25 XLM) from a factory-deployed smart account to a fresh account, via the native SAC. Correct key SUCCESS, wrong key FAILED. Reproduce: scripts/transfer-e2e.ts

smartWalletV1.note: passkey-kit v1 (v0.13.0, Protocol 27, audited) canonical testnet smart-wallet wasm. SoroPass targets its Signatures(Map<SignerKey, Signature>) ABI via signTransaction({ target: 'smart-wallet' }); shape confirmed by kalepail in issue #32.

addSignerProof.note: Multi-device recovery (Tranche 2 D1): deploy a passkey-kit v1 smart-wallet with passkey A, then enroll a SECOND passkey via @soropass/core addSigner (authorized by A), PERSISTED on testnet (txSuccess, invokeHostFunctionSuccess). Reproduce: pnpm --filter @soropass/core exec tsx scripts/add-signer-e2e.ts

demoRunProof.note: Full Tranche 2 D3 demo run on a passkey-kit v1 smart-wallet, all persisted: deploy -> fund -> passkey-signed payment (10 XLM via native SAC, sendSmartWalletTx) -> wrong-key payment REJECTED on-chain -> add second device (addSigner). Everything after deploy driven by @soropass/core. Reproduce: pnpm --filter @soropass/core exec tsx scripts/demo-run-e2e.ts

removeSignerProof.note: remove_signer proven against passkey-kit v1 on testnet: deploy wallet with A, add B, then remove B (all authorized by A, all persisted). Reproduce: pnpm --filter @soropass/core exec tsx scripts/remove-signer-e2e.ts

v1LifecycleProof.note: Full v1 account-lifecycle via SDK adapters (smartWalletV1Deployer + smartWalletV1Indexer): deterministic deploy -> deriveSmartWalletAddress (offline) === deployed address -> resolveByCredential(founding) -> wallet -> add second device -> resolveByCredential(second) -> SAME wallet. This makes connect/recover/getAddress v1-native. Re-verifies the paginated indexer (collectEventsToTip) that resolves recent wallets across the RPC event window. v0.13.0 event schema captured empirically (topic[0]=Symbol('signer_added'), topic[1]=SignerKey::Secp256r1(rawCredId), wallet=emitting contract) via scripts/v1-events-probe.ts. Reproduce: pnpm --filter @soropass/core exec tsx scripts/v1-lifecycle-e2e.ts
